description: exp023 - CONTROL: single-stream champion-lineage model with a PLAIN nn.Linear(E=384->V=32768, bias=False) unembedder (same as exp010's). Exact clone of exp022 with ONE change: HyperplaneCodeLUT unembedder -> Linear. Everything else byte-identical to exp022: single residual stream (no dual stream, no residual LUTs), LayerNorm everywhere incl ln_final before the unembedder, hyperplane_init=random scale 0.05 for all backbone LUTs (qk/v/out HyperplaneMHL), backbone 6L/E384/6h x d_qk=d_v=64/ctx512/vocab32768/RoPE1e4/untied tok_emb, LUT qk nap4/tph256 v nap6/tph256 out_proj nap7/tph512 (hard), seed 42, 16000 steps, 24576 tokens/step, LR over 16000 (warmup1600 cosine 0.1x floor), Lion lut_lr 2e-4 tables / AdamW adam_lr 3e-4 (hyperplane w/b no-wd by name; Linear unembedder wd0.1; tok_emb/norms wd0), grad clip 1.0, eval every 500. (code_unemb_* keys are vestigial/unused with the Linear unembedder.) Isolates the single-stream reduction FROM the unembedder: vs exp010 dual-stream+Linear 1.1940 isolates removing the dual stream; vs exp019/020/022 single-stream+code-LUT isolates the code-LUT cost. Param expectation: Linear 384*32768=12,582,912; total ~= 276.5M.
